steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Analysing dance performance involves watching closely and breaking down what you observe into component parts | Key Fact: Live performance offers a full sensory experience — you feel the energy, scale and atmosphere of the work | Key Fact: Recorded performance allows repeated viewing, enabling closer analysis of specific moments and details | Key Fact: A structured approach uses the four content categories: action, dynamics, space and relationships

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from analysing dance performance, and one past-paper question.
